text: そんな　カッコつけた　ぼうし　かぶっちゃってさー　おれに　くれよ！

structure.jp: そんな　カッコつけた　ぼうし

structure.en: going and wearing it, you know

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: カッコつけた　ぼうし
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase put right before a thing describes that thing. カッコつけた　ぼうし = 'a hat that is showing off'.

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: てしまう after a verb says someone went and did it, here with a sneer. ちゃう is the short spoken form, and ending on て leaves the complaint hanging. かぶっちゃって = 'going and wearing it'.
